GT_use: MSSD evaluation and per-pose labels only

tool.call: check(rows, draws=2000, seed=draw_index) in B and seed=0 in A

B.classic_pool: 33-19 E1 frozen classic150 CNOS+NOCTIS valid FP mask winners
B.xyzibd_pool: 33-19 E1e B1 base pool on all 150 frames, excluding raw unavailable early returns
B.sample: sorted (dataset, str(scene_id), str(im_id)) from all frozen frames including empty frames; random.Random(f'{dataset}|{score}|{k}').sample(keys, k)
B.quartiles: sorted effective pair counts including zeros; select index floor(q*n), capped at n-1 (paper replay convention)

outcomes.no_pairs: no opposite-label pair raised by check

B.RB1: all five classic fp_raw cells at k=10 have correct >= 90%
B.RB2: every classic dataset-score cell at k=10 has wrong <= 1%
B.RB3: first k with correct >= 90% per dataset-score cell; >20 if no such k
B.RB4: repeat RB1–RB3 within XYZ-IBD, primary reversal score fp_raw

C.C2_label_resolution: User semantic label '联合' identifies S22 C4. C2 is FP sign reversal and separately compared with C0 and C1.

ipd.reason: IPD P1 has B0 with C0 but lacks complete raw/reversed score rows. P2 is the complete B1 pool.

C.AP: Official BOP24 AP (MSSD/MSPD mean); read cached official geometry/matches. Same score ordering and unique clone identities for repeated images, consistent with 33-23.
C.averaging: five datasets equally weighted for image intervals; eligible datasets equally weighted for scene intervals, report corresponding AP points
C.fallback: Report both BCa and percentile. When both miss the point report paired leave-one jackknife SE and normal interval. Use scene jackknife at >=5 scenes, otherwise image; pooled equal-weight jackknife treats each dataset as a stratum at its available unit.
C.primary: Fixed BCa for RC1 and RC2. Also report residual noncoverage if an available percentile interval or requested normal fallback is shown alongside BCa.
C.RC1: entire interval < -10 pp: greatly reduces; entirely in [-1,+1]: equivalent; entire interval > +1: improves; otherwise indeterminate
C.RC2: number of differences whose primary interval excludes their points, by mode and scope

A.native_labels: existing pose caches, original symmetry-aware correct_labels
A.check_interval: Original and corrected exact tool 2,000-draw percentile intervals, in percent fractions
A.companion_intervals: 10,000 image/scene paired BCa under S23. Pair counts pooled; >=5 scenes per eligible dataset; pooled scene summary includes eligible datasets only.
A.RA1: list all reading changes relative to the original strict version of the same tool on identical rows
A.RA2: list all absolute changes strictly greater than 0.1 pp against archived strict values and show also comparison against archived ties-half values where available.
